title: Spend Elon Musk’s Money
gist: Wired and Neal Agarwal of Neal.fun built an interactive visualization that lets readers spend Elon Musk's trillion-dollar fortune. The scraped text contains only the teaser, reader comments and related links, not the article body.

insights.claim: WIRED partnered with Neal Agarwal of Neal.fun on an interactive data visualization of Elon Musk's trillion-dollar fortune that readers can spend themselves.
insights.speaker: Neal Agarwal
insights.so_what: Musk's wealth is now framed in popular media as a trillion-dollar scale object, an anchor for wealth-concentration discourse.
insights.quote: WIRED has partnered with Neal Agarwal of Neal.fun to create a visualization of Elon Musk’s massive wealth.
insights.locator: How Massive Is Elon Musk’s Trillion-Dollar Fortune?

insights.claim: Commenters reacted by proposing the money go to the UN, UNICEF, feeding the poor or helping the planet, and one called the spending exercise a product of human greed and the hedonic treadmill of consumption.
insights.speaker: Wired commenters
insights.so_what: Public reaction to extreme wealth skews toward moral framing of its use rather than the mechanics.
insights.locator: This is what comes from human greed
